correctness.rationale: PASS. For n>=3, ell>=1 the specified top-clique/apex model of mu_ell(K_n) has a finite simplicial label action. Geometric fixed barycentric coordinates are constant on each group orbit; admissible orbits are independent, and their conflict graph is an exact PL triangulation of the fixed set. A transitive subgroup has admissible lower-level orbits 0..ell-1 plus apex, with conflicts exactly the path P_(ell+1), giving the known mod-three path independence sphere/contractible homotopy types. For one fixed label plus one nontrivial other orbit the quotient conflict graph has W,A_0..A_ell,B_0..B_(ell-1), with the explicit between-level and apex conflict edges. Terminal A_(ell-1),A_ell are nonadjacent and have adjacent singleton neighborhoods (including ell=1); every independent face extends by one, and the two contractible vertex stars intersect in the star of their edge, proving contractibility. The fixed-space inclusion kills reduced homology when transitive fixed space is a sphere. The examined 90-case verifier corroborates orbit graph and star cover; universal n and ell are proved symbolically.
